name: Compulsory Traffic Insurance
tagline: The mandatory baseline cover. A vehicle may not be driven until it is in force.
applicableVehicles: Private cars and non-commercial passenger vehicles

coverages.title: Third-party injury and death
coverages.desc: Pays for injury or death caused to a third party within the liability limit, including medical costs, lost earnings, and care.

coverages.title: Third-party property damage
coverages.desc: Pays for direct property damage caused to a third party, shared by the degree of fault and capped by the limit.

coverages.title: Settlement without fault
coverages.desc: Where the insured vehicle is not at fault, the third party is still paid first within the liability limit.

coverages.title: Legal proof of roadworthiness
coverages.desc: A vehicle without compulsory cover may not be driven and cannot pass its annual inspection.

name: Commercial Cover · Basic
tagline: Third-party liability and occupant cover in one plan, built for everyday city driving.
applicableVehicles: Private cars and non-commercial passenger vehicles

coverages.title: Third-party liability ¥500,000
coverages.desc: Picks up where compulsory cover stops, covering both injury and property damage.

coverages.title: Occupant liability
coverages.desc: Pays for injury to the driver and passengers, insured per approved seat.

coverages.title: Roadside assistance, twice a year
coverages.desc: Towing, jump-starts, and fuel delivery, with towing covered up to 50 km.

coverages.title: Waiver of deductible
coverages.desc: Removes the fault-based deductible so qualifying claims are paid in full.

name: Commercial Cover · Comfort
tagline: Adds own damage cover and unlimited roadside assistance for everyday risk.
applicableVehicles: Private cars and non-commercial passenger vehicles

coverages.title: Third-party liability ¥1,000,000
coverages.desc: A high liability limit covering injury, death, and property damage to reduce out-of-pocket risk.

coverages.title: Own damage cover
coverages.desc: Collision, overturning, and natural disasters are covered at the vehicle's actual value.

coverages.title: Occupant liability
coverages.desc: Pays for injury to the driver and passengers, with limits selectable per seat.

coverages.title: Unlimited roadside assistance
coverages.desc: Towing, jump-starts, fuel delivery, and tyre changes with no annual cap; 30-minute response in urban areas.

coverages.title: Waiver of deductible
coverages.desc: Removes the fault-based deductible so qualifying claims are paid in full.

name: Commercial Cover · Premium
tagline: High liability limits, theft cover, and a dedicated claims adviser.
applicableVehicles: Private cars and non-commercial passenger vehicles (over ¥150,000)

coverages.title: Third-party liability ¥2,000,000
coverages.desc: Built for severe accidents, covering injury and property damage in one limit.

coverages.title: Own damage cover, including added equipment
coverages.desc: Covers aftermarket dash cams, sensors, and similar equipment alongside the factory specification.

coverages.title: Theft and robbery
coverages.desc: Loss from theft or robbery of the whole vehicle is paid at the vehicle's actual value.

coverages.title: Occupant liability
coverages.desc: Injury cover for the driver and passengers, with higher limits than Basic or Comfort.

coverages.title: Dedicated claims adviser
coverages.desc: One named adviser follows the report, assessment, and payout, responding live during support hours.

coverages.title: Designated driver, six times a year
coverages.desc: A designated driver within 20 km when you have been drinking or feel unwell.

name: Third-Party Liability
tagline: Third parties only, and the most direct top-up to compulsory cover.
applicableVehicles: Private cars and non-commercial passenger vehicles

coverages.title: Third-party injury and death
coverages.desc: Pays for injury or death caused to a third party, including medical costs, lost earnings, and care.

coverages.title: Third-party property damage
coverages.desc: Pays for direct damage to third-party vehicles, public facilities, and similar property.

coverages.title: Legal costs
coverages.desc: Arbitration and litigation costs arising from an accident are covered within the liability limit.

coverages.title: Waiver of deductible
coverages.desc: Removes the fault-based deductible so qualifying claims are paid in full.

name: Own Damage Cover
tagline: Your own car only, paid at the vehicle's actual value.
applicableVehicles: Private cars and non-commercial passenger vehicles

coverages.title: Collision and overturning
coverages.desc: Damage to your vehicle from a collision with another vehicle or object, or from overturning.

coverages.title: Natural disasters
coverages.desc: Damage from lightning, heavy rain, flooding, hail, and typhoons.

coverages.title: Falling objects
coverages.desc: Damage from falling objects, uprooted trees, and collapsing structures.

coverages.title: Waiver of deductible
coverages.desc: Removes the fault-based deductible so qualifying claims are paid in full.
